rule_gaps: Jernia's department crumb 'Oppbevaring og praktisk hjem' derives facets.type=Storage for locks, padlocks, door handles, door stoppers, plugs, power strips and sweeping sets (13 rows) — the type rule must read the breadcrumb LEAF, not the whole path

Rum21/Trademax/Chilli department crumbs 'Tekstil & Tepper' / 'Tekstiler & tepper' derive facets.type=Rugs for cushions, throws, tablecloths, table runners, pillow inserts and bed linen (9 rows) — same leaf-vs-path bug on the textile vocabulary
colour vocabulary misses Kid's palette words 'tåkeblå', 'himmelblå' and 'rose' (5 rows carry no colour)

'hvitevarer' (white GOODS) in a breadcrumb derives colour White; 'stål' as a colourway derives material Metal; 'clean cotton' as a SCENT derives material Cotton & linen; 'bambusskog' in a photo-mural title derives material Wood
Norwegian pet vocabulary is missing: 'hundeseng' and the 'Hund > Hundekurver og Tepper' breadcrumb land dog beds, mats and blankets in Home instead of Pets (3 rows)
notes: Data is broadly sane — every row is identifiable, priced and correctly Home-ish; the damage is concentrated in derived facets (two breadcrumb-path bugs account for 22 of 29 facet findings) and in un-wired variants (52 rows across 23 colour/size families, mostly Kid and JYSK textiles, each shipping as a separate top-level row with the colour only in the name). Category errors are a thin tail: pets (3), beauty (6), furniture (6) and kitchen (4). Notable one-offs: 'Gardiner på spesialmål' is a made-to-measure SERVICE priced at kr 1 and will win every cheapest-first sort in this category, and five same-name pairs (Eden tåkeblå, Fiona hvit, Iben hvit, Formsydd stretchlaken hvit) are indistinguishable because the shop's title omits the size. 145 of 300 rows (48%) have no image, consistent with sampled crawls rather than a data fault.
